principle: every file the build deliberately dropped from this archive is listed here, with a category and reason a verifier can check. files present in the live site's signed integrity.json but absent from this archive must appear in this manifest; anything else is unexpected.

categories.proprietary_asset: licensed binary the licence prohibits redistributing
categories.build_input: source file used to generate the public tree, not part of the published site
categories.internal_artefact: private operational file (credentials, infra, ssh keys, internal records)
categories.release_companion: file shipped alongside the archive at the release directory, not inside it
categories.transient: operating-system / editor / vcs scratch (caches, lockfiles, .DS_Store, etc.)
